authority: Ticket19 planning evidence; this artifact does not claim implementation acceptance or READY

requirementRegistry.integrityRule: The registry hashes every 04.tsv through 19.tsv source-bound requirement inventory; case and oracle traceability remains a separate incomplete layer.

requirementId.meaning: one immutable source-bound normative atomic clause
requirementId.sourceLocator: mutable metadata containing source path, heading anchor, current line, and clause ordinal

caseId.meaning: one immutable input plus fault schedule plus expected terminal scenario

oracleId.meaning: one immutable set of code, stage, digest or bytes, side-effect, and state assertions

replacementModels.requirementAndRendererCandidateMetadata: an issued record may retain a non-semantic supersededBy locator
replacementModels.appendOnlyConformanceRegistry: a new record lists replaced identities in supersedes and ACTIVE or SUPERSEDED is derived

caseRegistry.format: UTF-8 JSON Lines without BOM; one immutable case record per nonblank line
idPatterns: CONF::<one exact non-capacity family including SPEC_REGISTRY>::<six-digit-ordinal>

oracleRegistry.format: UTF-8 JSON Lines without BOM; one immutable oracle record per nonblank line
oracleRegistry.idPattern: ORC::<one of the ten exact Oracle families>::<six-digit-ordinal>

conformanceRegistries.groupingRule: Multiple requirements may share one case only when input, fault schedule, and expected terminal are all identical.
conformanceRegistries.oracleReuseRule: Reuse one oracle exactly when the observation boundary and canonical assertion set are identical; templates, wildcards, scripts, natural-language predicates, and default fallback are forbidden.
activeGraphRules: every active requirement has an active requirement-to-case-to-oracle-assertion path
every active case covers a requirement and assertion and proves each expected terminal
every active oracle has an active case reference
active case semantic signatures are unique
active oracle assertion signatures are unique
historical duplicate signatures occur only within one valid supersession chain with exactly one active record
supersession is acyclic, non-dangling, and followed by complete no-orphan validation
conformanceRegistries.inverseTraceability: generated validator output only; never a second fact source

rendererCertification.certificationGate: Complete transitive pins, patch/build/ICC/golden identity, ELF audit, and exact replay on two different-family non-virtualized physical Linux hosts are all mandatory.

contractBoundaryCorpus.isolationRule: Each generated case targets exactly one limitId; every other contract cell retains explicit safe margin.

combinedWorstPathCorpus.rule: Mutually exclusive endpoints or independently observable failure order require additional cases and can never reduce this minimum.

cases.title: RenderInput admission and bounded problem truncation
cases.objective: Exercise global request limits before grouping while semantic collection reaches the reserved marker boundary.
cases.expectedTerminal: bounded validation failure ending with PROBLEM_LIMIT_REACHED and no Evaluation

cases.title: Design structure, Expression, and canonical bytes
cases.objective: Reach jointly valid authored structure and expression boundaries while the pre-dependency canonical counting sink remains at its exact limit.
cases.expectedTerminal: dependency-free READY Save success with exactly one appended immutable revision

cases.title: Closure with authored Assets and static capabilities
cases.objective: Freeze the maximum valid closure together with static Asset atoms and capability sources before runtime state.
cases.expectedTerminal: successful closure admission with no hidden deduplication of authored units

cases.title: Repeat frames, materialized nodes, and operations
cases.objective: Combine Repeat collection, nesting, loop-frame, occurrence, node, generated-entry, and logical-operation boundaries without truncation.
cases.expectedTerminal: successful materialization at all selected exact limits

cases.title: Template invocations, viewports, and occurrences
cases.objective: Combine actual TemplateUse invocation depth/count, composition viewports, and final occurrence/document structure.
cases.expectedTerminal: successful RenderDocument seal with continuous opaque occurrence ordinals

cases.title: RenderDocument, manifest, and diagnostic sidecar seal
cases.objective: Reach document, one-to-one manifest, and complete sidecar boundaries in the same atomic pre-seal writer.
cases.expectedTerminal: successful atomic seal with no partial builder or sidecar exposure

cases.title: Asset occurrence and exact-content aggregates
cases.objective: Combine authored and resolved occurrences, unique logical/exact content, raw bytes, pixels, fonts, manifest, and URL budgets.
cases.expectedTerminal: successful ordered resolution with cache-independent accounting

cases.title: Capability state and demand aggregates
cases.objective: Combine static sources, state bytes, logical total/kind demands, call-position bytes, result digest bytes, and retry bounds.
cases.expectedTerminal: successful deterministic CapabilityState and result digest at exact limits

cases.title: Surface and request working set
cases.objective: Combine maximum legal surface with raw/decoded cache, decoder/encoder scratch, encoded buffer, and live RAM reservation.
cases.expectedTerminal: accepted execution and successful output without a hidden lower memory ceiling

cases.title: Font parsing and shaping aggregates
cases.objective: Combine unique fonts, tables, outlines, graphemes, glyph attempts/finals, lines, and font byte budgets.
cases.expectedTerminal: successful exact shaping with no system fallback

cases.title: Layout operations and paint structure
cases.objective: Combine measure, remeasure, layout operations, generated structure, paint items, and clip depth.
cases.expectedTerminal: successful layout at exact limits with deterministic order

cases.title: Raster overdraw and code modules
cases.objective: Combine legal surface pixels, painted pixel visits, paint chunks, QR/Barcode module cells, and final transforms.
cases.expectedTerminal: successful exact raster with no approximation or partial paint

cases.title: Encoded image, trace, multipart, and ephemeral bytes
cases.objective: Reach image, trace, framing, multipart total, encoder scratch, and request ephemeral boundaries together.
cases.expectedTerminal: successful atomic two-part response with exact digests

cases.title: Fetch retry, lease, and resource deadline
cases.objective: Use one retryable first-attempt failure, fixed backoff, a successful second attempt, exact byte accounting, and a lease valid through deadline plus margin.
cases.expectedTerminal: successful resource preparation without lease renewal or deadline reset

cases.title: Same-command registry join and replay
cases.objective: Submit concurrent and post-seal copies of one requestId and canonical digest.
cases.expectedTerminal: one execution and byte-identical joined or replayed terminal responses

cases.title: Registry identity conflict
cases.objective: Reuse one requestId with a changed digest or deadline while the original reservation exists.
cases.expectedTerminal: RENDER_REQUEST_CONFLICT for the changed command and no second execution

cases.title: Queue-full BUSY and accepted queue timeout
cases.objective: Fill one active slot and four FIFO positions, observe pre-accept BUSY for another command, then withhold a slot from an already accepted queued command for five seconds.
cases.expectedTerminal: nonterminal RENDER_ENGINE_BUSY before acceptance and terminal RENDER_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED after acceptance

cases.title: Cancel, seal, cleanup, and sealed replay
cases.objective: Linearize cancel immediately before seal for one request and immediately after seal for another, then replay only the sealed response within the fixed retention window.
cases.expectedTerminal: pre-seal RENDER_CANCELLED with zero output; post-seal success remains byte-identical; raw artifacts are not retained

editorRoutingInventory.meaning: routing, journey seeds, structurally split planning candidates, exact planning terminal/fault bindings, immutable semantic input fixtures, 189 mechanically determined target bindings, two exact no-working-copy absences, and one Editor-owned immutable dirty-guard source binding only; 46 first-layer source slots, 57 content-derived targets, and 62 UI observations remain pending, it issues no Case or Oracle, and proves no product or browser behavior

nonCapacityAtomicCorpus.countRule: Count unique atomic caseId entries after every normative requirement is mapped to at least one oracle-bearing case.

counts.fullAutomatedCorpus: 46 executable SPEC_REGISTRY cases plus 12 executable DOMAIN_SERVICES and 195 executable DESIGN_INPUT_EXPRESSION capacity cases; the remaining 318 isolated capacity, 18 combined, 108 non-issued Editor candidates, and still-unmapped nonCapacityAtomicCases remain non-executable

executionMatrix.assignmentRule: Every case declares exactly one most-downstream class; executor roles, targets, implementation revisions, runs, and evidence grades remain manifest-bound facts.
executionMatrix.readyRule: Every approved target replays its complete assigned corpus; additional executors and targets create runId records, not new caseId semantics.
executionMatrix.a3Rule: CI fixes target, manifest, case inventory, revisions, and artifact hashes and cannot skip profile corpus.
